answer: Re-attestations are stored in marble and river lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the dawn graph. Verification costs 8 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 2548 account sybil into a 8 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
